text:
mira: FYI—incoming ticket from Acme (acct acme-xyz) says applying a new promo replaced their existing trial credits instead of stacking. customer upset, says docs implied promo codes can be stacked. can we confirm behavior?

sanjay: assigning. do we have the account id/email? any request_id from support UI?

mira: email is jen.sanders@acme.com, support ticket ID 18294. she attached screenshots: balance went from $75 trial credit -> $0 after applying SUMMER2025. attached is the support note: 'I entered SUMMER2025 and my free credits disappeared'.

alex: pinging eng/runtime—this smells like a backend overwrite on promo_apply. @billing-bot can you dump recent promo_apply events for acme-xyz?

billing-bot: action=promo_events query_params={"account_id":"acme-xyz","limit":10} result_count=2
  - 1751500200 promo_apply TRIAL-50 amount=75 status=applied id=evt_8f3
  - 1751504310 promo_apply SUMMER2025 amount=50 status=applied id=evt_9ac overwrite=true

mira: overwrite=true shows up in the event log. customer says they never confirmed replacement.

sanjay: can you paste the API call stack from the support UI? are they using console or /v1/billing/promos/apply?

mira: support UI shows the request used POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/billing/promos/apply with body:
```
{ "code": "SUMMER2025", "account_id": "acme-xyz" }
```
Response was 200 with message "promo applied" and new balance 50. No additional warning text.

alex: here's a quick repro I've run locally: create account -> apply TRIAL-50 -> apply SUMMER2025. Backend upserts row in promos table with unique(account_id,promo_type) constraint and the apply call runs an upsert that replaces old credit if promo_type collides. Edge case: trial codes are stored with promo_type="promo_credit" for both trial and campaign promos, so second apply overwrites first.

lina: product note: our public docs say "some promo codes can be stacked; others cannot" — it's ambiguous. we need clear policy.

sanjay: immediate customer mitigation: grant equivalent $75 manual credit and escalate for refund of lost credit. I can create a manual credit but want approval from finance.

mira: customer asked for expedite. can we do manual credit now and follow-up with product?

sanjay: i'll create a temporary credit record: POST to /internal/billing/credits with body:
```
{ "account_id": "acme-xyz", "amount": 75, "reason": "support: overwritten promo - manual restore" }
```
Ticket note: manual credit created id=cr_774. cc: @finance for approval retrospectively.

alex: for a proper fix, options: 1) change promo_apply upsert to respect promo flags: allow_stack boolean per promo, 2) change promo_type classification so trials and campaign promos don't collide, or 3) add UI confirmation when existing credits will be replaced. I can prototype option 1 quickly.

lina: product prefers 1 + 3: allow promo-level stacking flag and also warn in UI when replacement will happen. also update docs to be explicit.

sanjay: logging/playbook: support should check promo_events for overwrite flag, confirm if overwrite=true, offer manual credit and escalate to billing with request_id and screenshots. adding to KB.

mira: I'll reply to customer: "We've restored your $75 credit and are investigating. We will follow up with timeline in 24 hours." :white_check_mark:

alex: small repro snippet for eng ticket (ENG-9876):
```
# repro steps
acct=$(curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/accounts -d '{"email":"temp@test"}')
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/billing/promos/apply -d '{"account_id":"$acct","code":"TRIAL-50"}'
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/billing/promos/apply -d '{"account_id":"$acct","code":"SUMMER2025"}'
# observe promo_events: second apply sets overwrite=true and replaces credit
```

alex: tagging ENG-9876. priority: P2 (customer impact + docs confusion).

lina: product will prep copy updates and define stacking rules by EOD tomorrow. support to get playbook snippet for KB.

sanjay: follow-ups: (1) manual credit created id=cr_774, (2) file ENG ticket ENG-9876 assigned to alex, (3) product to update docs and flagging system, (4) support KB update by mira.

mira: marking resolved for now with customer reply sent. will reopen if they report further issues. :thumbsup:

billing-bot: note=action_logged ticket=18294 escalated_to=engineering eng_ticket=ENG-9876 manual_credit=cr_774

mira: thanks team. closing thread unless eng asks for more logs.
